# The system packages Playwright 1.63.0 installs for Chromium on Ubuntu 24.04
# (`npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`: its "tools" and "chromium"
# lists for ubuntu24.04-x64, read from playwright-core). The Chromium package
# set in CI's cache must be whole for these: each on the runner or in the set,
# with everything each needs, and nothing else (.github/scripts/verify-installs.py,
# U5 fix 13). A new Playwright version can change them; the job then refuses
# until they are read again and committed here.
xvfb
fonts-noto-color-emoji
fonts-unifont
libfontconfig1
libfreetype6
xfonts-cyrillic
xfonts-scalable
fonts-liberation
fonts-ipafont-gothic
fonts-wqy-zenhei
fonts-tlwg-loma-otf
fonts-freefont-ttf
libasound2t64
libatk-bridge2.0-0t64
libatk1.0-0t64
libatspi2.0-0t64
libcairo2
libcups2t64
libdbus-1-3
libdrm2
libgbm1
libglib2.0-0t64
libnspr4
libnss3
libpango-1.0-0
libx11-6
libxcb1
libxcomposite1
libxdamage1
